content.title: Requests, errors and p95 latency by game
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend role = tostring(cloud_RoleName), fn = replace_regex(operation_Name, '^[A-Z]+ ', '')
| where role startswith 'func-g4k-'
| extend game = case(role == 'func-g4k-admin', tostring(split(fn, '-')[0]), role == 'func-g4k-portal', 'portal', substring(role, 9))
| summarize requests = count(), errors = countif(success == false), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0), players = dcount(tostring(customDimensions['g4k.user'])) by game
| order by requests desc

content.title: Requests over time by game
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend role = tostring(cloud_RoleName), fn = replace_regex(operation_Name, '^[A-Z]+ ', '')
| where role startswith 'func-g4k-'
| extend game = case(role == 'func-g4k-admin', tostring(split(fn, '-')[0]), role == 'func-g4k-portal', 'portal', substring(role, 9))
| summarize requests = count() by game, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart

content.title: Play minutes and players by game and day
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and name == 'game_session'
| extend game = tostring(customDimensions['game']), player = tostring(customDimensions['user'])
| summarize play_minutes = count(), players = dcount(player) by game, day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by day desc, game asc

content.title: AI calls by game
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where target has 'cognitiveservices.azure.com' or target has 'openai.azure.com'
| extend role = tostring(cloud_RoleName), fn = replace_regex(operation_Name, '^[A-Z]+ ', '')
| extend game = case(role == 'func-g4k-admin', tostring(split(fn, '-')[0]), substring(role, 9))
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false) by game, day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by day desc, game asc
